observed: Opaque square tower body behind paired front columns; four front columns per tower
Deep dark front apertures, thick layered square cornices and low curved crowns
Triangular pediments stand in front of the upper plinth; previous model obscured them
Upper central rear windows read dark behind the loggia
estimated: 2.80m tower width/2.20m depth and vertical subdivision
1.04m aperture width and0.48m front-to-back reveal depth
0.48m rise for a segmental crown; not an exposed hemisphere
0.98m forward shift for previously obscured pediments
Plain side and rear tower walls, without unobserved carved ornament
preserved: Original geographic anchor and ground footprint
Current red flags; old antenna not reconstructed
